services.name: Ocean Charters
services.desc: Salt-water fishing charters off the west coast of Vancouver Island - Gold River, Campbell River and Ucluelet. Chinook salmon, coho, halibut and lingcod with Captain Dennis Barnes. Season starting soon. West coast, mid-Island. Gateway to Nootka Sound - sheltered inlets and reliable chinook runs. Good for first-time ocean anglers and families. The Salmon Capital of the World. Tyee Pool, Discovery Passage, big tides and the biggest chinook of the season. Halibut runs out of Quadra and Cortes. West Coast, south of Tofino. Open-Pacific salmon and halibut grounds. services.name: Sunset / Night Bite
services.desc: Crystal-clear turquoise water north of Kelowna near Vernon - the "Lake of Many Colours." Year-round trophy rainbow trout in clarity-rich water, plus private sightseeing cruises with Outdoor Adventures BC. Kalamalka Lake is famous for its surreal turquoise colour - the result of calcium carbonate (marl) crystals reflecting sunlight off the lake floor. It's quieter than Okanagan Lake, less developed along the shoreline, and one of the most photogenic stretches of water in the Okanagan. We run Kalamalka outings on request - most common for guests staying in Vernon or Lake Country who want the novelty of a quieter lake. Same from $350 rate, same boat.
